**Mexican Municipalities to PEMEX Facilities**

```{r}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Distance from Mexican municipalities to nearest PEMEX facility,
# by facility type.
#
# Outputs one row per municipality with:
#   - distance to nearest facility of each of the 6 types
#   - name/ID of that nearest facility
#   - counts of facilities within 25 / 50 / 100 km bands
#   - an overall nearest-facility distance
#
# Distances in KILOMETERS, computed in EPSG:6372 (Mexico ITRF2008 / LCC).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------

library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)

MUN_PATH  <- "/Users/marileekarinshak/Desktop/Mexico_mun/Mun Shapefile/Mexico_mun_layer_simplified.shp" 
PTS_PATH  <- "/Users/marileekarinshak/Desktop/Mexico_mun/PemexInfrastructure Shapefile/PemexInfrastructurePoints.shp"

MUN_ID    <- "CVEGEO"     # municipality unique ID field
TYPE_FIELD <- "layer"      # facility type field in PTS_PATH
FAC_ID    <- "facility_n"   # facility name/ID field (for reporting which was nearest)

CRS_PROJ  <- 6372         # Mexico ITRF2008 / LCC -- meters
BANDS_KM  <- c(25, 50, 100)

OUT_CSV   <- "municipality_pemex_distances.csv"

TYPE_MAP <- c(
  "refinery"                        = "refinery",
  "gas processing complex (cpg)"    = "gasproc",
  "petrochemical complex"           = "petrochem",
  "storage & distribution terminal (tar)" = "storage",
  "marine terminal"                 = "maritime",
  "oil field"                       = "oilfield"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. LOAD + INSPECT
# ---------------------------------------------------------------

mun <- st_read(MUN_PATH, quiet = TRUE)
pts <- st_read(PTS_PATH, quiet = TRUE)

cat("Municipalities:", nrow(mun), "\n")
cat("Facilities:    ", nrow(pts), "\n\n")

cat("Facility type counts as read:\n")
print(table(pts[[TYPE_FIELD]], useNA = "ifany"))
cat("\n")
```

```{r}
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. CLEAN GEOMETRY + REPROJECT
# ---------------------------------------------------------------

# Fixes the QGIS "invalid geometry" error
mun <- st_make_valid(mun)
stopifnot(all(st_is_valid(mun)))

mun <- st_transform(mun, CRS_PROJ)
pts <- st_transform(pts, CRS_PROJ)

# Normalize type strings, then map to suffixes
pts$.type_raw <- str_squish(str_to_lower(as.character(pts[[TYPE_FIELD]])))
pts$.type     <- TYPE_MAP[pts$.type_raw]

unmapped <- unique(pts$.type_raw[is.na(pts$.type)])
if (length(unmapped) > 0) {
  stop("Unmapped facility types -- add these to TYPE_MAP:\n  ",
       paste(unmapped, collapse = "\n  "))
}
```

```{r}
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. CENTROIDS
# ---------------------------------------------------------------

cent <- st_centroid(mun)

# Some municipalities are crescent-shaped; their centroid falls outside
# the polygon. Substitute point-on-surface for those.
inside_own <- diag(st_intersects(cent, mun, sparse = FALSE))
n_out <- sum(!inside_own)
cat("Centroids outside own polygon:", n_out, "-> using point-on-surface\n\n")
if (n_out > 0) {
  st_geometry(cent)[!inside_own] <-
    st_geometry(st_point_on_surface(mun[!inside_own, ]))
}

```

```{r}
# check: should be 0
sum(!diag(st_intersects(cent, mun, sparse = FALSE)))

# confirm nothing got dropped or NA'd
nrow(cent)
sum(st_is_empty(cent))
```

```{r}
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. DISTANCE ENGINE
# ---------------------------------------------------------------

# One row per feature in `ref`; columns suffixed with `tag`.
nearest_by_type <- function(ref, ref_ids, pts, tag) {
  
  types <- sort(unique(pts$.type))
  
  per_type <- map(types, function(tp) {
    sub <- pts[pts$.type == tp, ]
    if (nrow(sub) == 0) return(NULL)
    
    # distance matrix: nrow(ref) x nrow(sub), meters
    D <- matrix(as.numeric(st_distance(ref, sub)), nrow = nrow(ref))
    
    idx  <- apply(D, 1, which.min)
    dmin <- D[cbind(seq_len(nrow(D)), idx)] / 1000   # -> km
    
    res <- tibble(
      !!paste0("dist_", tp)    := dmin,
      !!paste0("nearest_", tp) := as.character(sub[[FAC_ID]])[idx]
    )
    for (b in BANDS_KM) {
      res[[paste0("n_", tp, "_", b, "km")]] <- rowSums(D <= b * 1000)
    }
    res
  })
  
  out <- bind_cols(compact(per_type))
  
  # overall, across all types
  Dall <- matrix(as.numeric(st_distance(ref, pts)), nrow = nrow(ref))
  out$dist_any <- apply(Dall, 1, min) / 1000
  for (b in BANDS_KM) {
    out[[paste0("n_any_", b, "km")]] <- rowSums(Dall <= b * 1000)
  }
  
  out <- bind_cols(tibble(!!MUN_ID := as.character(ref_ids)), out)
  names(out)[-1] <- paste0(names(out)[-1], "_", tag)
  out
}
```

```{r}
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. RUN
# ---------------------------------------------------------------

res_cent <- nearest_by_type(cent, mun[[MUN_ID]], pts, "cent")
res_edge <- nearest_by_type(mun,  mun[[MUN_ID]], pts, "edge")

final <- full_join(res_cent, res_edge, by = MUN_ID)

# hosting indicators
hosted <- st_intersects(mun, pts)
final$n_hosted  <- lengths(hosted)
final$hosts_any <- final$n_hosted > 0
```

```{r}
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. SANITY CHECKS
# ---------------------------------------------------------------

type_suffixes <- sort(unique(pts$.type))
dist_cols <- paste0("dist_", type_suffixes, "_cent")
dist_cols <- dist_cols[dist_cols %in% names(final)]

gap <- abs(do.call(pmin, c(as.list(final[dist_cols]), na.rm = TRUE)) -
             final$dist_any_cent)

cat("--- checks ---\n")
cat("Rows:", nrow(final), "(expected", nrow(mun), ")\n")
cat("Duplicate IDs:", sum(duplicated(final[[MUN_ID]])), "\n")
cat("NA distances:", sum(is.na(final$dist_any_cent)), "\n")
cat("Max gap, min-of-types vs dist_any:", round(max(gap, na.rm = TRUE), 6),
    "km  [should be ~0]\n")
cat("Municipalities hosting >=1 facility:", sum(final$hosts_any), "\n\n")

cat("Centroid distances by type (km):\n")
print(summary(as.data.frame(final[dist_cols])))

```

```{r}
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. EXPORT
# ---------------------------------------------------------------

write.csv(final, OUT_CSV, row.names = FALSE)
cat("\nWrote", OUT_CSV, "--", nrow(final), "rows x", ncol(final), "cols\n")

write.csv(final, "~/Desktop/municipality_pemex_distances.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```
